outputs.summary_en: The image shows a woman with her mouth open, seemingly shouting or cheering, with her hand near her mouth, amidst a crowd of people. The BBC News logo is visible in the bottom left corner. The image likely depicts public celebrations in India following the successful Chandrayaan-3 moon landing.

claims.claim_original: The image shows people in India celebrating the successful landing of Chandrayaan-3 near the Moon's south pole.
claims.claim_en: The image in this post shows people in India celebrating the successful landing of Chandrayaan-3 near the Moon's south pole.

outputs.visual_description_en: A close-up photo shows a woman in a yellow garment, with a red bindi on her forehead, shouting or cheering with her mouth open and her right hand near her mouth. She is wearing a ring on her right ring finger and heart-shaped earrings. In the background, other people are visible, also appearing to be part of a crowd, with some raising their hands. A man with glasses and a beard is partially visible on the left. The BBC News logo is in the bottom left corner of the image.
